- **Workload Balance**: Needs improvement to prevent burnout and ensure sustainable productivity.

## Recommendations

- **Increase Resolution Capacity**: Allocate more resources or streamline processes to increase ticket resolution rates and reduce backlog.

- **Focus on Critical Issues**: Prioritize the resolution of critical issues to mitigate risks and maintain service quality.
- **Monitor Burn Rate**: Regularly review workload distribution and adjust resource allocation to maintain a sustainable burn rate.
- **Reduce Resolution Time**: Investigate bottlenecks in the resolution process and implement strategies to reduce average resolution time.
- **Regular Retrospectives**: Conduct sprint retrospectives to identify issues affecting velocity and implement continuous improvements.
